children: Conyers Investments Llc, a 10% owner, reported the sale of Class B common stock in two transactions on September 14 and September 15, 2026. The transactions were sales at $11.55 and $11.15 per share, respectively, for a weighted average price of $11.49 per share. The total proceeds from the sales were $3,810,733. Conyers Investments Llc directly owns 22,001,890 Class B common shares following the reported transactions.
